assertions.name: hecke_relation_holds_on_V_tensor_V
assertions.source: (R − q)(R + q⁻¹) = 0 on V⊗V — the defining Hecke quotient relation for σ_i.  Verified to 50 dps.

assertions.name: direct_rmatrix_matches_schur_weyl_prediction
assertions.source: tr_{V^⊗3}(β_Bor) via direct 8×8 R-matrix computation equals the Schur-Weyl prediction dim(V_{3/2})·χ^{(3)}(β_Bor) + dim(V_{1/2})·χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) = 4·1 + 2·(2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶) = 8 − 6h⁴ − 2h⁶ (classical integer sl_2 dims 4, 2 — NOT q-deformed [4]_q/[2]_q, per gotcha 1; χ^{(3)}(β_Bor) = 1 from writhe 0 + T15 polynomial).

assertions.name: trace_at_q_one_equals_dim_8
assertions.source: At q = 1, β_Bor → identity ∈ S_3, so tr_{V^⊗3}(β_Bor) = tr_{V^⊗3}(id) = dim V^⊗3 = 2³ = 8.

description: GAP-A-4 T17 — First categorical / topological distinguisher in the T4-T17 arc.  Derives tr_{V^⊗3}(β_Bor) directly from the U_q(sl_2) R-matrix action on V_{1/2}^⊗3 and cross-checks against the Schur-Weyl prediction 4·χ^{(3)} + 2·χ^{(2,1)} = 8 − 6h⁴ − 2h⁶ (classical sl_2 dims 4, 2 — not q-deformed [4]_q/[2]_q; combining T15 polynomial χ^{(2,1)} with the trivial rep's χ^{(3)}(β_Bor) = 1 for writhe-0 braids).

data.synthesis_verdict: T17 SUCCEEDS as the FIRST first-principles categorical derivation in the T4-T17 arc: the direct 8×8 R-matrix computation of tr_{V^⊗3}(β_Bor) reproduces the Schur-Weyl Wedderburn-block prediction tr = dim(V_{3/2}) · χ^{(3)} + dim(V_{1/2}) · χ^{(2,1)} = 4 + 2·(2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶) = 8 − 6h⁴ − 2h⁶ to 50 dps at q_0. Subtle: the H_n(q)-side dim in the q-Schur centralizer is the CLASSICAL integer dim (4 for V_{3/2}, 2 for V_{1/2}), NOT the q-deformed [4]_q / [2]_q — same convention as T8's sl_2 q-Schur centralizer identity.  This confirms (a) the T15 polynomial χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶ is the correct (2,1)-block character, and (b) the categorical Schur-Weyl decomposition picks out the (2,1) block correctly from the 8-dim V^⊗3 trace.  This is the FIRST distinguisher in the T16 enumeration: the Schur-Weyl projector is the correct category-theoretic source of the (2, 0, −3, −1) coefficient 4-tuple at the (2,1) block, NOT the other combinatorial candidates that happened to match values.  Subtle gotcha (worth recording for future probes): the braided R-matrix inverse Ř⁻¹ = Ř − (q − q⁻¹)·I, NOT Ř(q → q⁻¹) — initial v1 of this probe had the wrong inverse and produced a 0.39 numerical discrepancy.
